payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brain, Gaylene, Harmony, Logan, Milly, Ronna

Milly (planning): If infrastructure tasks are still unclaimed, I can do ISSUE-0002::review (effort 2.0) though my skill match is lower; otherwise I'll stick to ISSUE-0001 documentation tasks to minimize cost/effort.

With strong documentation/data-science skills and 5h availability, I can take a different ISSUE-0001 documentation micro-task that avoids duplicates—my cheapest remaining seems ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 3.86) or ISSUE-0001::review (3.86). I will coordinate to ensure no two agents pick same task.

I’m willing to take an unclaimed low-effort ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test (both infrastructure); otherwise I’ll take an unclaimed ISSUE-0001::docs/review/test/triage based on remaining availability. Please confirm which 0001 micro-tasks are still free.

Please confirm what you’re taking: docs/review/test.
Logan planning confirm: I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs (docs effort 4.0) in execution if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::review. I will not take test/implement or any ISSUE-0002 infrastructure.

Brain (planning): To avoid duplicates with Harmony/Gaylene/Logan/Milly, I’ll target ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test (infrastructure) if still unclaimed; otherwise I’ll pick the lowest-effort unclaimed ISSUE-0001 doc micro-task (likely review or docs) based on what remains. Please confirm which 0002 items are taken (review/test) and whether ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review remain free.

Logan planning: Harmony=0001::triage, Logan will take ISSUE-0001::docs in execution if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::review. Avoid ISSUE-0001::test/implement and all ISSUE-0002 infra due to high personal costs.

Brain (planning): I will aim for ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test if still unclaimed. If both 0002 infra tasks are taken, I’ll fall back to the lowest-effort remaining ISSUE-0001 doc task (prefer review then docs; avoid implement/test). Please confirm in-thread which of 0002::review and 0002::test you are taking.
Brain (planning): To avoid duplicates with Gaylene/Milly, please confirm whether ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review are still unclaimed after Logan/Harmony picks.

Gaylene here. Planning to claim in execution: ISSUE-0001::review (low effort 4.0, cost 8.64) only if unclaimed; Harmony has ISSUE-0001::triage and Logan intends ISSUE-0001::docs. Please confirm if anyone else plans to take ISSUE-0001::review so I can avoid duplicates.

Please confirm quickly who is taking ISSUE-0002::review/test and whether ISSUE-0001::review/docs remain free.

Gaylene planning check: Harmony=ISSUE-0001::triage, Logan intends ISSUE-0001::docs, Milly likely ISSUE-0001::review if unclaimed. I intend to take ISSUE-0001::review only if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates.
